mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of secondary living space for my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Secondary dwelling units can be designed as attached in-law suites, converted garages, or detached cottages, each serving different household goals. If your priority is keeping aging parents close for care while eliminating steps, an attached suite with accessibility features—such as walk-in showers and wide doorways—is often ideal. If privacy and independent living for adult children or guests are paramount, a detached backyard cottage provides complete separation from the main household. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms helps homeowners evaluate their lot layout to choose the most functional configuration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an attached suite for close daily caregiving and easy access, or a detached backyard unit if you require complete noise separation and independent living arrangements.
